latestCharge.description: First charge of the subscription. Card charges settle immediately; pix and boleto stay pending and carry their expiry and payment instructions

expiresAt.description: Present only on pix and boleto charges: when payment expires

failureReason.description: Present only when the gateway declined the charge

paymentInstructions.description: Present only on pix and boleto charges: what the customer pays with

cardToken.description: Gateway card token, charged immediately for the first period. Never returned by the API

oneOf.description: Pix and boleto create the subscription as incomplete with a pending first charge until it is paid; any cardToken sent is ignored

parameters.description: Client-generated key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters). The same key with the same request replays the first response with the header Idempotent-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body answers 422; the same key while the first request is still running answers 409
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: The attempt ran. A failed charge is retried as a new attempt; a pending charge past its attempt lease is reconciled with the gateway. charge.status is paid or failed once the gateway decided, and stays pending when the gateway is unavailable, its outcome is unknown or it has not decided yet; retry again later

409.description: The charge cannot be retried: it is paid, its subscription is canceled, it was modified concurrently, or it is pending with an attempt still in flight within the lease (CHARGE_ATTEMPT_LEASE_SECONDS); or a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed

422.description: The subscription has no card token or the customer has no gateway customer; or the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request

503.description: An Idempotency-Key was sent and the idempotency store is unavailable

200.description: Development only: marks the pending pix or boleto gateway charge of our charge id as expired
Development only: marks the pending pix or boleto gateway charge of our charge id as paid

204.description: Development only: empties the fake gateway data file
Development only: replaces the card token charged on the next attempt

parameters.description: Client-generated key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters). The same key with the same request replays the first response with the header Idempotent-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body answers 422; the same key while the first request is still running answers 409
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

409.description: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed

422.description: The request cannot be processed, or the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different body

503.description: The gateway is unavailable, or an Idempotency-Key was sent and the idempotency store is unavailable

parameters.description: Internal endpoint called by the payment gateway. Format t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>." + raw body>. Rejected with 401 when missing, malformed, mismatched or when t is more than 5 minutes away from the server clock
parameters.name: x-gateway-signature

200.description: The event was received. Also the answer for a duplicated event id, an unknown charge and a transition the charge state machine rejects; the outcome is recorded in webhook_events

400.description: The signature is valid but the payload is not a gateway event

401.description: The signature header is missing, invalid or out of the allowed window
